hardware.variant: R5 LittleFS network appliance. Ordinary reboot from NOR.

inputs.name: Installed R5 root image before temporary timing instrumentation

scenario: During one normal reboot, sample the native sh SECONDS variable on the producer side before and after rcorder and each run_rc_script invocation. Buffer timestamps and exit statuses in shell memory and emit one final rc.log record. Use the host monotonic UART clock for the independent root-mount and login markers.
expected: Obtain both boundaries and an exit status for every configured startup script; retain the normal boot order.
observed: All 13 scripts and rcorder returned status zero. The scripts account for 183 s and the initial order calculation for 35 s. Another 35 s falls outside those intervals within the 253 s producer window. The broader rc.log date markers span 257 s. The R5 syslogd pre-start function separately calls rcorder -k chrootdir on the selected scripts. None of those scripts declares that keyword.
limits: One instrumented software reboot. The earlier uninstrumented cold POWER boot took 177 s between the rc.log date markers. Its per-script times were not recorded.
SECONDS uses whole seconds of board wall time. A script measurement includes its shell setup and pre-start operations through return, and background processes may become ready later.
UART observations use a different clock and different boundaries. The cost of the nested rcorder call inside syslogd was not separately timed.
